en.title: OpenAI's Quarterly Revenue Tops $10 Billion ⚡
en.description:
OpenAI's quarterly revenue has reportedly crossed $10 billion for the first time, up from $6.7 billion the quarter before. Will this pace last?
Source: TechCrunch
